rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=1, unet_c=32, itnet_alpha_init=0.0026, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.00025, pretrain_epochs=15, pretrain_patience=15, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=1200, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=ITER-5 (breast itnet_v2 search-20260703-01, strict 20-min budget). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): trajectory -> iter1 k=4/c16 hr0.0000; iter2 k=1/c16 hr0.3382; iter3 k=2/c16 hr0.2098 (k monotone-decreasing, k=1 LOCKED); iter4 k=1/c32 hr0.3830 (PSNR33.02 SSIM0.9227 RMSE0.00984, alpha0.0015) = current BEST. (2) FAILURE MODE: doubling width (c16->c32) helped (+0.045 hr), confirming capacity mattered; but the pretrain loss has floored near ~1e-6 (train-PERFECT) at only train_n=600 while val PSNR (33.02) still trails the FBP baseline (36.32) -> the residual gap is now a GENERALIZATION / DATA-quantity gap, not optimization: the denoiser memorizes 600 scenes perfectly yet under-generalizes to the 200 val scenes. breast has 3600 train cases available and I have held train_n=600 for all 4 prior iters. (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 600 -> 1200 (2x training scenes). ALL else identical to iter-4 (the c32/k1 champion): itnet_k=1, unet_c=32, alpha_init=0.0026, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=2.5e-4, pretrain_epochs=15, patience=15, grad_clip=1.0, val_n=200, seed=42. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if train_n 600->1200, val hr rises above 0.3830 because more diverse training scenes reduce the train-perfect / val-gap overfit (a data-quantity fix for a model that already drives train loss to ~0), improving generalization to the held-out val scenes. FALSIFIER: if hr <= ~0.385 (flat), 600 scenes already saturated the c32 denoiser's generalization and the residual gap is an intrinsic single-DC-step-vs-FBP ceiling (then a Step-3 TPE around k=1/c32 + a lower-alpha / residual_learning-True probe is the next move, not more data). (5) BUDGET: 2x train scenes ~2x the pretrain epoch cost; iter-4 (c32/k1/n600) finished well inside budget, pretrain floored by epoch ~3 so 15 epochs at 1200 scenes is still comfortably < 1200s (val=200 + figure fixed). (6) FINAL of the 5-iter onboarding block; I report the trajectory when iter-5 lands.
